text: The staffing process involves all the activities related to the acquisition and utilization of human resources. Which of the following is NOT a part of the staffing process?
explanation: Compensation is a part of the remuneration process, not the staffing process. Staffing process includes recruitment, selection, training, and placement.
subject: Business Studies

text: Internal recruitment sources are more cost-effective than external sources. True or False?
explanation: Internal recruitment sources are more cost-effective than external sources because they save time and money. Internal sources also reduce the risk of selecting an unsuitable candidate.
subject: Business Studies

text: Which of the following is an example of an off-the-job training method?
explanation: Vestibule training is an example of off-the-job training method where trainees are trained in a separate area before they are allowed to work on the actual job.
subject: Business Studies

text: The selection process involves evaluating the suitability of a candidate for a particular job. Which of the following is NOT a part of the selection process?
explanation: Placement is a part of the staffing process, not the selection process. Selection process involves evaluating the suitability of a candidate for a particular job.
subject: Business Studies

text: Which of the following is a benefit of on-the-job training?
explanation: On-the-job training is cost-effective because it saves time and money. It also improves productivity and reduces turnover because trainees learn the skills and knowledge required for the job.
subject: Business Studies

text: The staffing process is a continuous process. True or False?
explanation: The staffing process is a continuous process because it involves the acquisition and utilization of human resources. It requires constant evaluation and improvement to ensure that the organization has the right people with the right skills and knowledge.
subject: Business Studies

text: Which of the following is an example of a psychological test used in the selection process?
explanation: Personality test is an example of a psychological test used in the selection process to evaluate a candidate's personality and behavior.
subject: Business Studies

text: The selection process involves evaluating the suitability of a candidate for a particular job. Which of the following is a step in the selection process?
explanation: Interviews are a step in the selection process where the candidate is evaluated based on their skills, knowledge, and behavior.
